ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Bina Kishore Chhabria, a promoter of Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL), sold 5.5 million shares (1.97% of total equity) via an open market transaction on September 23, 2026. This reduced her individual stake from 58.20% to 56.23%, consequently lowering the overall promoter group holding from 80.91% to 78.94%. While the promoter group retains substantial control, this divestment by a key insider could raise questions about liquidity needs or future outlook and warrants further investor scrutiny.
